_comment: Windows example — copy this file to config.json and edit to match your environment.
_sessions_dir_note: Leave as "auto" (recommended): the resolver locates the store and survives Anthropic moving it (MSIX repackage, publisher-hash rename, prefix change, etc.). To pin a literal path instead, see SESSION-STORES.md.
_output_dir_note: Any local folder works. For a NAS, use a UNC path like \\server\share\claude-sessions.

format._comment: Do not edit unless the JSONL *schema* changes. Location, folder-prefix, and nesting-depth changes are handled automatically by the resolver.
